Visitor returns rendered template as a bare string (not a dict) and original mixed-case content is preserved end-to-end (regression guard for issue #350)

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

type testVisitorVisitorLinkBareStringPreservesCase struct {
	htmd.BaseVisitor
}

func (v *testVisitorVisitorLinkBareStringPreservesCase) VisitLink(ctx htmd.NodeContext, href string, text string, title *string) htmd.VisitResult {
	return htmd.VisitResultCustom(fmt.Sprintf(`[%s](https://new-cdn.com/file.pdf)`, text))
}

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	visitor := &testVisitorVisitorLinkBareStringPreservesCase{}
	options.Visitor = visitor
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<a href="https://old-cdn.com/file.pdf">Download</a>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result)
}
```
